description: How many minutes of work does it take in a country to earn the world price of a commodity?. Joins ILOSTAT mean hourly earnings (USD, by ISCO occupation) with World Bank Pink Sheet commodity prices for the same year. Returns minutes of work per unit (kg, barrel, troy oz, tonne), units per hour of work, history and the spread across occupations. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /items (limit); /answer (country*, item*, occupation, limit); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /items, /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: wage-hours
